title: NYC 311 Heat / Hot Water Requests - 2024
source: NYC Open Data - 311 Service Requests from 2020 to Present (erm2-nwe9)
query: complaint_type = 'HEAT/HOT WATER' AND created_date between '2024-01-01T00:00:00' and '2024-12-31T23:59:59'
cleaning: Kept every calendar-year 2024 HEAT/HOT WATER request, normalized non-five-borough values to Unspecified, and aggregated the full extract by month, borough, reported scope, weekday, hour, and status for responsive browser-side filtering.
